desc: Reports on the reproducible status of installed packages
u: reproducible-check - Reports on the reproducible status of installed packages

usage: reproducible-check [-h] [-d] [-r] [--version]

Reports on the reproducible status of installed packages. For more details please see <https://reproducible-builds.org>.

options:

-h, --help
show this help message and exit
-d, --debug
show debugging messages
-r, --raw
print unreproducible binary packages only (for dd-list -i)
--version
print version and exit
